n = int(input())
B = int(input())
data = [int(input()) for _ in range(n)]

totalCuts = 0
oddCount = 0
evenCount = 0
maxDifferences = []

for i in range(n):
    if data[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1
    if evenCount == oddCount and evenCount != 0 and i != n - 1:
        maxDiff = abs(data[i] - data[i + 1])
        maxDifferences.append(maxDiff)

maxDifferences.sort()

for maxDiff in maxDifferences:
    if B >= maxDiff:
        totalCuts += 1
        B -= maxDiff

print(totalCuts)
</translated_code>
